name: Rath Yatra (Grand Chariot Festival)
description: World-renowned annual procession of Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra in majestic chariots along the Bada Danda in Puri, concluding with Bahuda Yatra.

name: Ashokashtami & Rukuna Ratha Yatra
description: Car festival of Lord Lingaraj celebrated in Bhubaneswar's ancient Ekamra Kshetra with traditional Kalinga rituals and holy water drawing.

name: Maha Shivaratri & Jagara
description: Grand nocturnal vigil at Lingaraj Temple and Dhabaleswar Temple culminating with the Mahadipa offering atop the temple pinnacle at midnight.

name: Chandan Yatra
description: 21-day summer water festival celebrated with divine boat processions (Chapa Khela) in the sacred Narendra Sarovara in Puri.

name: Durga Puja & Silver Filigree (Chandi Medha)
description: Historic autumnal celebration in Cuttack featuring exquisite Tarakasi (silver filigree) pandal tableaus and divine Shakti worship.

name: Bali Yatra (Maritime Heritage Fair)
description: Asia's largest open-air trade and cultural fair on the banks of the Mahanadi in Cuttack
column7: commemorating ancient Odia Sadhabas' maritime voyages to Bali

name: Konark Dance & Music Festival
description: Prestigious classical Indian dance and music performances held every December against the illuminated backdrop of the UNESCO World Heritage Konark Sun Temple.
